title: Out-of-bounds write in certain ASUS Router firmware allow an unauthenticated nearby attacker to write data beyond the…
description: Certain ASUS Router firmware versions contain an out-of-bounds write vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated nearby attacker to write data beyond the intended buffer. This flaw can potentially be exploited to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) condition via a crafted packet. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-84729 and has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.2. No specific affected versions or patch information are provided in the available data.
